gpt-4o-mini.title: The Century of Revolution. 1603-1714.

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Revolutionary: Samuel Adams
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: An insightful biography that explores the life of one of America's founding fathers and his role in the revolution.

gpt-4o-mini.title: England Under The Tudors

gemma2:9b.title: Unbroken: A World War II Story of Survival, Resilience, and Redemption
gemma2:9b.explanation: Memoir detailing Louis Zamperini's experiences as a WWII POW in a Japanese camp.

gemma2:9b.title: The Nightingale
gemma2:9b.explanation: A novel set during WWII France following two sisters who resist the Nazi occupation.
